subhead: Britain's top diplomat said Wednesday he regretted Israel's decision to close the UK consulate in Jerusalem over London-led sanctions over settler violence in the occupied West Bank. title: French billionaire Olivier Bouygues stands trial for killing protected birds
subhead: The businessman and five of his employees were accused of setting up a reward system for killing endangered species at a country estate. Prosecutors requested a suspended five-year prison sentence and a €750,000 fine for Bouygues.

title: In Toulouse, the French government auctions off a historic monument it has held for 70 years
subhead: The Georges Pauilhac mansion, a stunning Art Nouveau building, is set to be sold in November. Starting price: €2.1 million.

title: Iceland's no vote does not undermine the EU's appeal
subhead: Driven in part by concerns over reopening the issue of fishing rights, the Icelandic referendum at the end of August disappointed supporters of European integration. Yet the EU continues to be seen as a stable regional center of governance that many other partners still want to draw closer to.

title: In Los Angeles, thousands of Americans are forced to live in their cars
